user_reported_bug: Production Android APK: Razorpay checkout modal opens, UPI apps (PhonePe/GPay/Paytm) icons are visible, but tapping them does NOTHING — the UPI app never launches. On the same website (Chrome browser), Razorpay works fine and UPI apps launch correctly. Only Android APK is affected.

action_items: Build/install the production Android APK on a real Android device and tap PhonePe/GPay/Paytm from Razorpay checkout to confirm the external UPI app launch end-to-end; this runtime step is not possible in the preview browser/container.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/android/app/src/main/java/com/parasreward/prc/MainActivity.java handles intent:// with Intent.parseUri(url.toString(), Intent.URI_INTENT_SCHEME), adds FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK, calls startActivity(intent), and returns true on dispatch.

The same shouldOverrideUrlLoading override now handles direct schemes upi, phonepe, tez, paytmmp, paytm, gpay, bhim, and credpay with new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, url) + FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK + startActivity(intent).

Both ActivityNotFoundException handlers return false, allowing Razorpay fallback behavior, and non-UPI schemes return super.shouldOverrideUrlLoading(view, request) so Capacitor navigation/security handling remains in effect.
/app/frontend/android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml has <queries> with generic VIEW upi intent plus explicit packages including PhonePe, GPay, Paytm, BHIM, Amazon Pay, WhatsApp, and CRED.

Attempted Android Java compilation via ./gradlew :app:compileDebugJavaWithJavac, but the container has no JAVA_HOME/java; this is an environment limitation, not a code failure observed by the static checks.

rca_of_the_issue: The original APK-only symptom is consistent with Android WebView failing to handle non-http(s) Razorpay deep links. The fix adds WebView URL interception for intent:// and direct UPI/payment schemes, dispatching them as Android ACTION_VIEW intents while returning false when no target app is found so Razorpay can continue to its fallback UI.
